title: metadata-server: support -05 Binary values
description: From audit JMAP-t8ej.5 (Mark's metadata-05 list review, finding 7; https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/jmap/lUjY9HLnx9Cgm8sA05qQTJTqZIU/). draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-05 §2.1.1 adds Binary objects (@type: "Binary", base64); the crate has none. Gaps: value_depth (crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/validate.rs:42) counts a Binary as depth >=1, -05 says 0; no invalidProperties for a malformed Binary (extra members, non-padded/invalid base64; §3.2 rule 5, after the depth check in check_metadata_depth validate.rs:332); filter paths descend into Binary members (resolve_path filter.rs:103) and text conditions can match the base64 string (filter.rs:177, :220), -05 says paths cannot address Binary members and text never matches one; apply_jmap_patch (crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs:677-697) must return invalidPatch for a path through a Binary. Oracle: the -05 §2.1.1 example and rule text (~/GIT/ietf-jmap-drafts). Leave the review's open questions (pad bits, whole namespace value as Binary) alone until the list answers.
